preconditions.description: The input x must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output is the space-separated concatenation of each word in the input transformed by the inside-out rule.

postconditions.expression: all(len(inside_out_word(word)) == len(word) for word in x.split())
postconditions.description: Each transformed word has the same length as the original word.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(inside_out_word(word)) == sorted(word) for word in x.split())
postconditions.description: Each transformed word is a permutation of the original word (same characters, same counts).
